title: oreodaphne rigida var. pohlii
intro: Oreodaphne rigida var. pohlii, commonly known as Rigida, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Oreodaphne rigida var. pohlii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
